biography.background: Originally from Illinois. Iraq War combat veteran who served with the Marine Corps 2000–2004. Active firefighter. Father. Green Party of North Carolina candidate. Visited the West Bank and has spoken publicly about the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. Appeared on 'Behind The Shield' podcast (Episode 984, September 25, 2024) discussing the Iraq invasion, firefighting, and his observations from the West Bank. No prior elected office held. Advocates no corporate donations to his campaign.
